# Fuels - Properties Database

Online petroleum-based fuels properties database for accessing comprehensive fuel specifications and properties.

## Resource

- [AFDC Fuels Properties Database](http://www.afdc.energy.gov/afdc/fuels/properties.html)

## Description

This tool provides access to the Alternative Fuels Data Center (AFDC) fuels properties database, which contains detailed information about various petroleum-based fuels including:

- Physical and chemical properties
- Performance characteristics
- Specifications and standards
- Comparative data across fuel types

Use the provided link to access the online database for the most current fuel properties information.
